page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.small is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the ecs.s6 shared instance family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile is built on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Compute capacity is allocated via 1 shared vCPU paired with 4.0 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory proportion.

Storage and acceleration components reflect a baseline cloud virtual machine profile. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage disks for operating system and data requirements. There are no hardware GPUs present, and the baseline network bandwidth is designated at 0 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses provided by default.

Because the vCPU is provisioned under a shared CPU allocation model, CPU execution time is multiplexed across the underlying physical processor, exchanging dedicated sustained compute cycles for qualitative resource and budget efficiency. This configuration fits low-intensity operational tasks, such as light web serving, continuous integration runners, lightweight background microservices, and development or testing environments.
